propositions.canonicalProposition: At a fixed 0.5% alert rate, card-not-present fraud value detected rose from 61% (January to March 2023) to 74% (July to September 2023) after the retrained model went into use in May 2023, according to the memo obtained from the model risk office.
propositions.rationale: The verification note records a memo obtained from the employer with a fixed alert rate and two defined periods; the resume describes the retraining.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate retrained the gradient-boosted fraud model and recalibrated its alert thresholds with the fraud strategy managers at a 0.5% operating point.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the retraining and the work sample records the operating point and sign-off.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate reviewed 64 strategy rules and proposed retiring 17, of which the fraud strategy managers approved 15.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the review and its outcome directly.

expectedGap: The training-set work covers confirmed third-party fraud and chargebacks; first-party fraud labelling is not described.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the detection result with its fixed alert rate, both periods and the employer-supplied memo, describing it as following the model change rather than as the candidate's sole result; keep the documented rule review.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask whether the candidate has built labels for first-party fraud and how those cases were identified.
